item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
What's New in 0.3.1

  • Push-to-talk actually works now. Voice capture uses manual turn detection instead of server VAD, so releasing the button reliably sends what you said instead of sometimes triggering a generic greeting.
  • Empty captures (tap without speaking) no longer ask the agent to respond.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
What's New in 0.3.0 — Archibald is alive

  • He blinks now. Natural, irregular blinks — quick to close, slower to open, the occasional double-blink — and heavier lids as he gets drowsy.
  • He visibly thinks. After you finish talking, Archibald turns a soft violet, knits his brows, and glances up-and-aside while composing his reply — no more dead air.
  • Polite eyes. Instead of staring at your cursor nonstop, he holds your gaze a few seconds, glances away, and re-engages — with quick saccades instead of dreamy drifting.
  • A real mood. One emotional engine now drives his breathing, blink rate, fidget energy, and colors. Ignore him long enough and he falls asleep (dark-slit eyes, slow breaths); summon him and he startles awake.
  • Listening is warm amber now instead of alarm-red, and losing the connection gets a confused head-shake and slate dimming instead of silence.
  • Expressive brows while speaking — they lift with his volume and flutter with the texture of his voice.
  • He stays out of your way. When you're actively working (fast cursor movement), he suppresses his idle fidgets. Reduce Motion is now respected across all animations.
  • API keys moved to the macOS Keychain. Existing keys migrate automatically and the plaintext copies are scrubbed from preferences.
  • Sturdier connection. Auto-reconnect with conversation resume when the socket drops, plus live in-progress transcription of what you're saying.
  • Assorted animation fixes: reactions ease out instead of snapping, wide-eyed attention now lasts the whole time he's listening.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
What's New in 0.2.1

  • Fixed orb facing inward on first launch. On a cold start the entrance animation was getting interrupted by cached settings publishers, leaving Archibald frozen mid-pivot toward the screen center. He now finishes the slide-in and faces you straight on, same as a hide/show cycle.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
What's New in 0.2.0

  • File Collections. Pick a folder; Archibald keeps it mirrored to an xAI Collection and the voice agent can search it during a conversation. Auto-creates the collection on first run; uses a security-scoped folder bookmark; watches the folder via FSEvents.
  • Click the orb to start/stop recording. Fixed an event-routing bug where clicks were swallowed by the 3D view and by macOS dropping "first clicks" on the non-activating panel.
  • Orb floats above other windows. No longer hides behind Finder, Chrome, etc.
  • Show animation no longer gets stuck. Bringing the orb back with ⌥+\ after hiding now reliably plays the slide-in, even with rapid show/hide toggles.

item.description:
What's New in 0.1.3

  • Add support for multiple voice agents
